name: SportsCampProgramManager
tagline: Holiday camp register with safe collection, live staff ratios and medical flags – one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: A complete holiday sports camp module: tablet sign-in/sign-out, authorised collectors and collection passwords, consent and medication checks at check-in, age groups with live staff-to-camper ratios, not-arrived and late-collection alerts, and a medical & collection view for safeguarding leads.
features: Check-in/out with time stamps and undo
Collector verification: authorised list, password, leave-alone consent
Check-in blocked without consent form or critical medication
Age groups and live staff ratio breaches with Add cover
Not-arrived and late-collection alerts per session
Bulk check-in / absent / cancel with reasons
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
